input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and the carve-outs in 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), the payment-obligations carve-out, and the mutual consequential-damages exclusion in 21.2 all meet the preferred position. The quantum fails the fallback: "Fees" is defined at 1.5/1.8 as the Implementation Fee only — a one-time USD 12,000 charge stated in the first Order Form — and the cap is further limited to the first Order Form. The effective cap is therefore about USD 12,000 regardless of subscription spend, well below 12 months' fees and below even six months' fees (walk-away territory). Minimal fix: restate the basis in 21.1 as the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, leaving the rest of Section 21 intact.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis in 21.1: greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms, or USD 1,000,000
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently keys off "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is effectively USD 12,000 and far below our floor. We have changed the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000; Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, wilful misconduct) remain outside the cap. If USD 1,000,000 is an issue, we can fall back to a straight twelve months' fees cap across all Order Forms.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
